sageh.source: Yearly Goals.xlsx 'Sage GL History' tab — read fresh every run per SKILL.md §2c; baked payload is only the fallback (never splice null). R35: optional disc ($, GL-negative) + gross series from the Discount % column. R37: optional nrMgn / cbMgn / wtyMgn series — the Non-Rev / Callback / Warranty Margin columns, dollars exactly as the Summary card's Margin row (negative = loss; blank → 0; all three to BOTH trades or to neither). The R36 nrEro/cbEro/wtyEro keys are RETIRED — no Excel column ever carried them. The Trends margin section hides when a payload lacks the keys

june_parity.caveat: R38: membership revenue moves revenue/GM whenever goals.json carries mem keys — June parity holds ONLY when the goals payload has no mem block (mem absent → byte-identical to R37, verified).

release_rule: A template revision is NOT released until, in the SAME session: (1) this template.html + manifest are re-frozen in the repo, (2) the skill bundle is re-saved with the matching pp_template.html and SKILL.md, (3) the nightly task prompt carries no stale revision facts. Nightly: if the skill folder SKILL.md states a HIGHER revision than this manifest, that is a broken release — STOP and report; never silently publish the older engine.
notes: R38 (2026-07-30): Membership revenue — non-job club-membership revenue + material cost join the P&L. Build splices full-month branch totals from the 'Other Revenue' block of the Yearly Goals Excel (Margin Variables tab), split 94/6 HVAC/Plumb into PP_GOALS[trade].mem (read at boot like maturity — no localStorage, no UI dial; saved copies inherit via embedded PP_GOALS). computeAll: rev=revJob+memRev (MTD = monthly x calendar elapsedFrac — rev/elapsedFrac paces to completed pace + full monthly membership exactly); memCost lands in Purchases; grossRev/gp/cp/discP/eroP and every % re-base to TOTAL revenue; modeled % vars (burden/ccFee/rebate/invBurn/referral) stay on JOB revenue. Summary Revenue tile gains completed+membership small-text callout, Purchases tile a membership-cost note, recon bridge a membership term. P&L splits Completed / Membership / Total Revenue and adds a Membership cost Purchases line (job-materials line nets it out). Trends: two informational split rows above Total Revenue under the MTD Pace anchor (Sage months don't split — LM/PY/3M comparisons live on Total Revenue); paceVals gains revJob + memRev. Verified 2026-07-30 jsdom A/B vs R37 on the July 07/01-07/29 exports (3,689 jobs, $5,427,932, gates 6/6 all builds, builtAt equalized): mem ABSENT → 18/18 rendered panes byte-identical to R37 (sum/dept/recon/pnl/trends-pace/trends-lm x 3 scopes); mem PRESENT ($130K/$57K) → deltas exact to the dollar in all scopes (Branch rev +121,613 = 130,000x29/31, GM$ +68,290; HVAC +114,316/+64,193; Plumb +7,297/+4,098; pace +130,000/+122,200/+7,800 exactly); RAW identical; dept card identical except eroP re-base. Parsers, job-level math, buckets, flags, accrual, Handoff and review machinery untouched. build.js and close.js run VERBATIM (mem nests inside the trade objects goals.json already forwards wholesale).

mem.source: Yearly Goals.xlsx 'Margin Variables' tab — 'Other Revenue' block (Membership row: Revenue $ + Purchases $, branch monthly totals)
mem.split: 94% HVAC / 6% Plumbing, applied at ingest into PP_GOALS[trade].mem={rev,cost}
mem.behavior: MTD = monthly x calendar elapsedFrac; pace carries the full monthly figure exactly; cost lands in Purchases; all margins/% re-base to TOTAL revenue; mem absent/invalid → renders exactly R37
